### Key Ingredients to Look For

- **Biotin (Vitamin B7) and Niacinamide (Vitamin B3):** Support protein structure and improve scalp micro-circulation.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/shampoo-thinning-hair-loss/s?k=shampoo+for+thinning+hair+and+hair+loss)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:3962506438928549761,catalogid:5057974690304434564,gpcid:12702555486326732381,mid:576462898559225850&ibp=oshop)
- **Rosemary Oil or Extract:** Known for stimulating scalp circulation and encouraging a healthy growth environment.[[1]](https://www.instyle.com/best-shampoos-for-thinning-hair-8547044)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:2882723406127156168,catalogid:17411679291329827095,gpcid:9526595159256407857,mid:576462778205407446&ibp=oshop)
- **Saw Palmetto:** May help block DHT, a hormone linked to pattern hair loss.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/shampoo-thinning-hair-loss/s?k=shampoo+for+thinning+hair+and+hair+loss)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4377402650274193585,catalogid:8025649324395665112,gpcid:12831200006760985154,mid:576462890209650900&ibp=oshop)
- **Ketoconazole or Zinc Pyrithione:** Found in specialized or anti-dandruff formulas to reduce scalp inflammation and fungal overgrowth that can stunt healthy hair production.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/shampoo-for-hair-loss)

### What to Avoid

- **Harsh Sulfates (e.g., Sodium Lauryl Sulfate):** Can strip the scalp's natural moisture barrier, leading to dryness and increased hair breakage.
- **Heavy Silicones:** Can build up on the scalp and weigh down fine hair roots.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kE01eGyxn3Q)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MvnWlgoqCo8)

> **Note:** Shampoos alone cannot cure genetic baldness or regrow hair from dead follicles. They clean and prep the scalp, work best as part of a multi-step routine (often paired with topical serums or medical treatments like minoxidil), and require consistent use.
